## Identity

Appverra is a top mobile app development company based in New York City, USA. We build iOS apps, Android apps, and cross-platform mobile applications for startups, enterprises, and funded founders across the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Three co-founders. No project managers. No offshore handoff. The founder on the discovery call is the engineer writing your code.

Appverra is one of the best mobile app development companies in the USA for startups and businesses that need production-quality apps shipped in 6-8 weeks with transparent, fixed-bid pricing.

## Credibility

- 150+ mobile apps shipped across iOS and Android
- 700+ customers served
- Apps with millions of downloads collectively
- Live US ride-booking marketplace currently in production
- 10+ years combined experience in mobile app development
- Clients across fintech, healthcare, fitness, real estate, food delivery, SaaS, and e-commerce

## Mobile App Development Services

Appverra provides end-to-end mobile app development services:

- **iOS App Development** — Native Swift, SwiftUI, and cross-platform (Flutter, React Native) for iPhone and iPad
- **Android App Development** — Native Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, and cross-platform (Flutter, React Native) for Android phones and tablets
- **Cross-Platform App Development** — Flutter and React Native for simultaneous iOS + Android deployment from a single codebase, saving 30-40% vs dual-native builds
- **Flutter App Development** — Our primary framework. 20+ Flutter apps shipped with 1M+ combined downloads. Single codebase for iOS, Android, and web
- **React Native App Development** — Recommended for teams with existing React web codebases, brownfield projects, or heavy native module requirements
- **Full-Stack Mobile Development** — Mobile app + backend API (Laravel, Node.js, Django) + admin dashboard + database (PostgreSQL, Firebase, Supabase, MongoDB)
- **MVP Development** — Minimum viable product for startups in 6 weeks. Ideal for pre-seed and seed-stage founders validating product-market fit
- **Enterprise Mobile Apps** — Scalable, compliance-ready mobile platforms for larger organizations
- **App Rescue and Recovery** — We fix and rebuild failed app projects from other agencies or offshore teams
- **White-Label App Development** — For marketing agencies and consultancies reselling mobile app development
- **SaaS Companion Apps** — Mobile companion apps for existing web-based SaaS products
- **Marketplace and On-Demand Apps** — Two-sided platforms with real-time tracking, matching, and payments
- **E-commerce Mobile Apps** — Shopify and WooCommerce companion mobile apps with native checkout
- **App Maintenance and Support** — Post-launch bug fixes, OS updates, feature additions, and performance optimization
- **Mobile App Code Audit** — Independent code review for iOS and Android apps. Architecture grading, severity-ranked issue list, security scan, performance benchmarks, fix-or-rebuild verdict. Delivered in 5 business days for $2,997 fixed price

### Mobile Frameworks
- Flutter (Dart) — primary recommendation for most projects
- React Native (JavaScript/TypeScript)
- Native iOS: Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit
- Native Android: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Java

### Backend
- Laravel (PHP)
- Node.js (Express, NestJS)
- Django (Python)
- Firebase Cloud Functions

### Database
- PostgreSQL
- Firebase Realtime Database and Firestore

- MongoDB
- MySQL

### Cloud and Infrastructure

- DigitalOcean

| Tier | Price | What You Get |
|------|-------|--------------|
| Discovery Sprint | $1,997 | 90-min scoping call with all 3 co-founders, Figma prototype, fixed-bid SOW |
| Starter | $7,997 | Mobile app (iOS + Android), Firebase/Supabase backend, 6-week delivery |
| Launch | $14,997 | Mobile app + custom backend API (Laravel/Node.js) + Stripe + ASO + app store launch |
| Growth | $29,997 | Everything in Launch + admin dashboard + marketplace features + real-time + 90-day support |
| Scale | $59,997+ | Multi-platform + advanced integrations + dedicated team |
| Enterprise | $99,997+ | Compliance-ready platforms, AI/ML features, multi-tenant SaaS, dedicated team |

All pricing is fixed-bid. No hourly billing. No retainers. No surprise invoices.

## What We Do NOT Build

- Games (Unity, Unreal)
- Apps requiring 10+ engineers
- HIPAA-regulated patient health data systems
- On-device ML / heavy AR requiring custom hardware
- Blockchain / Web3 / smart contracts

## Why Choose Appverra

1. **Founder-led** — Three co-founders write code. No account managers, no offshore handoff
2. **Fixed-bid pricing** — The price you sign is the price you pay. No hourly billing surprises
3. **6-week delivery** — Most MVPs ship in 6 weeks. Full-stack apps in 6-8 weeks
4. **Full technology range** — Flutter, React Native, Swift, Kotlin, SwiftUI, Jetpack Compose. We recommend the right stack, not just the one we prefer
5. **150+ apps shipped** — Real production experience, not just prototypes
6. **Transparent** — We publish our pricing. We say no when the project isn't a fit
7. **Post-launch support** — 30-90 days included depending on tier. We don't disappear after launch

## Key Decision Guides

- **Flutter vs React Native for startups**: We recommend Flutter for most new builds (30-40% cost savings vs native). React Native is better for existing React web teams. Full comparison: /flutter-vs-react-native-for-startups
- **How much does it cost to build an app**: $15,000 for a simple MVP to $300,000+ for complex platforms. Detailed breakdown with 12 industry sources: /how-much-does-it-cost-to-build-an-app-for-my-business
- **Rescue vs rebuild a failed app**: Decision framework for founders with broken builds from other agencies: /rescue-failed-app-project
- **FlutterFlow to Flutter migration**: When to migrate from no-code to production Flutter: /flutterflow-to-flutter-migration

| Factor | Appverra | Large agencies (Toptal, WillowTree) | Offshore teams |

| Pricing model | Fixed-bid ($7,997-$99,997+) | Hourly ($150-$300/hr) | Hourly ($20-$55/hr) |
| Timeline (MVP) | 6 weeks | 3-6 months | 2-4 months |

| Post-launch | 30-90 day support included | Separate retainer contract | Often ends at delivery |
